summary: VS MEDIA Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on September 11, 2026 disclosing eight unsecured loan agreements dated August 3, 2026 with individual lenders, aggregating S$1,047,000 (approximately US$830,952). Each loan carries a six-month term from disbursement and 10% per annum simple interest; proceeds fund working capital and business development. Disbursement flows through subsidiary Aurenza Living Private Limited as receiving agent. Obligations are unsecured with no guarantees, prepayable without penalty, Singapore law governs, and default triggers after five business days' notice. This is routine financing, not a special situation.
